slices.focus: Eric and Danielle hold a kitchen-table intervention with Trevor about his indefinite basement stay, producing a written three-month job-search and chore plan taped beside the garage freezer, which lowers household tension from constant low-grade irritation to clearer but still crowded coexistence.
slices.summary: Household tension with Trevor reaches a breaking point; Eric initiates a blunt family talk resulting in a written three-month agreement with measurable expectations, reducing ambiguity and protecting Maya from the emotional weather.
open_loops: Whether Trevor will follow through on the three-month plan
